title: Understanding Gradient Descent
text: Think about how batch and stochastic gradient descent differ in terms of the data they use to compute the gradient. Does one use the entire dataset while the other uses a subset?

title: True Gradient Calculation
text: Consider what it means to compute the "true gradient" of the loss surface. Is it possible to achieve this with only a portion of the data?

title: Batch vs. Stochastic Gradient Descent
text: Which of the following statements is true about batch and stochastic gradient descent?
choices: Batch gradient descent uses the entire dataset to compute the gradient.
Both methods compute the true gradient of the loss surface.
Stochastic gradient descent uses a single data point to compute the gradient.
